stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def bars_of(g, bgc=5):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bgc and not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]);seen[i][j]=True;cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft();cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==c:
                            seen[x][y]=True;q.append((x,y))
                rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
                vert = max(rs)-min(rs) >= max(cs)-min(cs)
                out.append(dict(cells=cells,color=c,vertical=vert))
    return out

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bs=bars_of(inp,inp[0][0] if False else None)
    # determine bgc and seed color from data: bg = most common; seeds = isolated singletons
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    singles=[p for p in bs if len(p['cells'])==1]
    seed_c=singles[0]['color']
    n=len([p for p in bs if len(p['cells'])==1])
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    def bg(x,y): return out[x][y]==bgc
    # seeds: rays rightward until non-bg; seed -> 4
    for (r,c) in singles:
        out[r][c]=4
        for cc in range(c+1,W):
            if not bg(r,cc): break
            out[r][cc]=seed_c
    # walls that fire: no seed in its band; fill = n x gap rectangle flush against wall along band, top-aligned
    for brk in bs:
        if len(brk['cells'])<n or brk['vertical']:
            pass
    verts=[brk for brk in bs if len(brk['cells'])>1 and not brk['vertical']]
    for brk in verts:
        band=[p[0] for p in brk['cells']]
        # horizontal bands: band cells share same row? vertical bar -> band = rows
        if brk['vertical']:
            bt=min(band); bw=max(band)+1  # rows bt..bw-1
            gp = sum(1 for cc in range(brk['cells'][0][1]+1,W) if bg(bt,cc))
            rp=list(range(bt, bt+n))
            cp=list(range(brk['cells'][0][1]+1, brk['cells'][0][1]+gp+1))
            for (rr,cc) in ((r_,c_) for r_ in rp for c_ in cp):
                if bg(rr,cc): out[rr][cc]=seed_c
        else:
            # horizontal bar: fill above/below
            bc=max([p[1] for p in brk['cells']])
            gp=sum(1 for rr in range(bc, H) if bg(rr, brk['cells'][0][1]))
            rp=list(range(bc-gp, bc))
            cp=[bc]
            for (rr,cc) in ((r_,c_) for r_ in rp for c_ in cp):
                if bg(rr,cc): out[rr][cc]=seed_c
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    print(k, solve(I)==O)
    print('pred:',[(r,c,solve(I)[r][c],O[r][c]) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if solve(I)[r][c]!=O[r][c]])

def solve(inp):
    from collections import deque, Counter
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; comp=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if inp[i][j]!=bgc and not seen[i][j]:
                c=inp[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]);seen[i][j]=True;cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft();cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and inp[x][y]==c:
                            seen[x][y]=True;q.append((x,y))
                comp.append(dict(cells=cells,color=c,single=(len(cells)==1)))
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    def bg(r,c): return out[r][c]==bgc
    # walls = multi-cell; seeds = singles. seed color = 9? Use the singleton's color.
    sc=None
    for d in comp:
        if d['single']: sc=d['color']; break
    out_sc=sc
    seeds=[d for d in comp if d['single']]
    walls=[d for d in comp if not d['single']]
    # each seed fires toward nearest wall sharing its row or column; seed -> 4, ray paints out_sc
    for s in seeds:
        r,c=s['cells'][0]
        out[r][c]=4
        # choose direction: among N,E,S,W, those lines contain a wall cell; pick shortest distance
        cand=[]
        # N
        if any(c==cc for cc,_ in [None,None]): pass
        for dr,dc,side in ((-1,0,'N'),(1,0,'S'),(0,-1,'W'),(0,1,'E')):
            rr=r+dr*1; cc=c+dc*1; dsc=0
            ok=True
            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and bg(rr,cc):
                dsc+=1; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
            # find nearest wall in this line
            rr_,cc_=r+dr*1,c+dc*1
            mind=-1;mdist=None
            while True:
                if not (0<=rr_<H and 0<=cc_<W): break
                wcells=[p for p in walls for p_ in []][:0]
                # find wall cells in this row or col
                wlist=[w for w in walls if any(p[0]==rr_ and p[1]==cc_ for p in w['cells']) or any(p[1]==rr_ and p[0]==cc_ for p in w['cells'])]
                wlist=[w for w in walls if any(p[0]==rr_ for p in w['cells']) or any(p[1]==rr_ for p in w['cells'])]
                if rr_!=r or cc_!=c:
                    wlist=[w for w in walls if any(p[0]==rr_ for p in w['cells'])]
                for w in wlist:
                    for p in w['cells']:
                        dd=abs(rr_-p[0])+abs(cc_-p[1])
                        m=max(md,dd)
                pass
    return out

import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter, deque

def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    bg=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c,n in vals.items() if c!=bg]

    def get_comps(col):
        seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); out=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if I[i][j]==col and not seen[i][j]:
                    q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cs=[]
                    while q:
                        y,x=q.popleft(); cs.append((y,x))
                        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    vals=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    bg=max(vals,key=vals.get)
    others=sorted(set(v for r in I for v in r)-{bg},key=lambda c:-vals[c])
    dot_c=others[-1]; bar_c=others[0]
    res=[r[:] for r in I]
    # dots -> 4
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if res[y][x]==dot_c: res[y][x]=4
    # fill bg runs touching a bar cell (any direction? try horizontal runs)
    for cy,cx in [(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if I[y][x]==bar_c]:
        # shoot left and right from this bar cell
        for dxx in (-1,1):
            yy,xx=cy,cx+dxx
            while 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and res[yy][xx]==bg:
                res[yy][xx]=dot_c
                xx+=dxx
    return res

def f(I):

    from collections import Counter
    vals=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    bg=max(vals,key=vals.get)
    dot_c=[c for c in vals if c!=bg and vals[c]==1][0]
    bar_c=[c for c in vals if c!=bg and c!=dot_c][0]
    res=[r[:] for r in I]
    # flood fill bg cells; each connected component's color depends on... let's compute components
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    comps=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if res[y][x]==bg and not seen[y][x]:
                q=deque([(y,x)]); seen[y][x]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and res[na][nb]==bg and not seen[na][nb]:

                comps.append(cells)
    print('ncomps',len(comps),'dotc',dot_c,'barc',bar_c,'bg',bg)

steps.input:
# Hypothesis: for each row with a dot (minority color) and a bar (majority):
#   ray from dot toward bar, fill dot+1..bar-1 with minority color; 
#   minority object is MARKED: bars -> 4, dots -> erased (bg).
# If no partner in the row: ray to the opposite edge (away from nearest edge).
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    others=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bg]
    # minority color (victim), majority (survivor)
    m=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); s=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    for y in range(H):
        row=[(x,v) for x,v in enumerate(I[y]) if v!=bg]
        if not row: continue
        dots=[p for p,v in row if v==m]; bars=[p for p,v in row if v==s]
        if not dots and not bars: continue
        dd=set(dots); bb=set(bars)
        def mark(x,c):
            if c==s: out[y][x]=4
            elif c==m: out[y][x]=bg
        if dots and bars:
            d0=dd.pop(); b0=bb.pop()
            if d0<b0:  fcells=list(range(d0+1,b0))
            else:     fcells=list(range(b0+1,d0))
            for x in fcells: out[y][x]=m
            mark(d0,m); mark(b0,s)
        elif dots:   # no bar: ray toward opposite edge
            d0=dd.pop()
            if d0>=(W+1)//2:
                fcells=list(range(0,min(d0)))
                fcells=[x for x in fcells if x<d0]
            else:
                fcells=list(range(max(0,d0+1),W))
            for x in fcells: out[y][x]=m
            mark(d0,m)
        elif bars:   # no dot: ray to opposite edge from bar
            b0=bb.pop()
            fcells=[x for x in range(b0+1,W)]
            for x in fcells: out[y][x]=m
            mark(b0,s)
    return out
for name,(I,O) in {'d7':(G['Demo pair 7 input'],G['Demo pair 7 output']),'d8':(G['Demo pair 8 input'],G['Demo pair 8 output'])}.items():
    P=solve(I)
    print(name, 'MATCH' if P==O else 'MISMATCH')
    if P!=O:
        for y,(r,o) in enumerate(zip(P,O)):
            if r!=o: print(y, ''.join(map(str,r)), '->', ''.join(map(str,o)))

def solve(grid):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # label colors as singletons vs multi-comps
    def comps(c):
        seen=set(); res=[]
        for y in range(H):
            for x in range(W):
                if grid[y][x]==c and (y,x) not in seen:
                    st=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x)); cur=[]
                    while st:
                        a,b=st.pop(); cur.append((a,b))
                        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            p,q=a+dy,b+dx
                            if 0<=p<H and 0<=q<W and grid[p][q]==c and (p,q) not in seen:
                                seen.add((p,q)); st.append((p,q))
                    res.append(cur)
        return res
    info={}
    for c in set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{bg}:
        cs=comps(c)
        info[c]=(len(cs),cs)
    # wall color = one with a multi-cell comp; singles = other color cells
    w=None; s=None
    for c,(n,cs) in info.items():
        if any(len(x)>1 for x in cs): w=c
        else: s=c
    assert w is not None, info
    # handle demo8-style extra same-color comps: pick the color containing largest comp
    order={}
    best=max(info.items(), key=lambda kv:max(len(x) for x in kv[1]))
    wc=max(best[1], key=lambda x:(-(x[0]>1), True))  # largest comp
    sw=[c for c,info_ in info.items() if c!=wc][0]
    # singles list
    sing=[(y,x) for y,x in grid if grid[y][x]==sw]
    # for each single, find nearest wall cell (any, min manhattan); shoot straight line
    # direction: straight axis aligned when possible; take wall cell minimizing |dy|+|dx|, tie -> smallest dx*sign
    results=set()
    for y,x in sing:
        cw=[(py,pw) for py,pw,_ in [(cw,)]]
        cw=[(p[0],p[1]) for p in []]+[(p[0],p[1]) for o in [None]]
        cw=[(py,pw) for r in [] for (py,pw) in []]
        cw=[(py,pw) for py,pw,o in [(py,pw,info[wc][1] if False else None)] for py,pw in [] ]
        break

from collections import Counter

def solve(grid):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # colors: keep track of which is which; we identify "bar" color as the majority non-bg color
    nbg={c:(sum(1 for r in grid for v in r if v==c), c) for c in cnt if c!=bg}
    sorted_c=sorted(nbg.items(), key=lambda t:-t[0])
    bar_c=sorted_c[0][1]
    minority_c=sorted_c[-1][1]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    
    # locate bar cells (non-bg, non-minority color? careful: minority could be multi-comp too)
    bar_cells=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) 
               if grid[y][x]!=bg and grid[y][x]!=minority_c]
    minor_cells=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if grid[y][x]==minority_c]
    
    def shoot(y,x,tgt_y,tgt_x):
        # ray from (y,x) toward (tgt_y,tgt_x), one axis at a time
        dy=(tgt_y-y)//max(1,abs(tgt_y-y)); dx=(tgt_x-x)//max(1,abs(tgt_x-x))
        cur=y+dy*(0 if dy==0 else dy); px=x
        if dy==0:
            p=q=0
        steps=[]
        p,q=y,x
        while True:
            p+=dy; q+=dx
            if not(0<=p<H and 0<=q<W): break
            if grid[p][q]!=bg: break
            out[p][q]=minority_c
        # if a minority cell was crossed, erase it (mark 4)
        pass
    
    for m in minority_cells:
        y,x=m
        candidates=[]
        for by,bx in bar_cells:
            d=abs(by-y)+abs(bx-x)
            # prefer cells sharing a row or column
            pref=0 if (by==y or bx==x) else 1
            candidates.append((d,pref,by,bx))
        best=min(candidates,key=lambda t:(t[0],t[1]))
        by,bx=best[2],best[3]
        # direction: toward bar; stop before bar cell; if no bar, go toward grid center
        if by==y and bx==x: continue
        ty,y_=y,bx
        if by==y:
            # same row: shoot horizontally
            p,q=y,x
            sign=1 if bx>x else -1
            while 0<=p<H and 0<=q<W and grid[p][q]==bg:
                out[p][q]=minority_c
                q+=sign
            # mark the hit bar cell as 4
            out[y][x+sign]=(4 if (bx,y) not in minority_cells else None)
        elif bx==x:
            sign=1 if by>y else -1
            while 0<=p<H and 0<=q<W and grid[p][q]==bg:
                out[p][q]=minority_c
                p+=sign
            out[p][x]=4 if (p+sign,x)==(by,bx) else out[p][x]
    
    return out
